401910042.summary: Most sources lean Phoenix: the Suns have won three straight (seven of nine) while New Orleans has lost three straight and nine of ten, with Murray, Mathurin and Watford out. ESPN's BPI gives Phoenix 75%. One computer model (BettingNews) splits and leans New Orleans in a near coin flip.
401910042.pick: PHX to win (Bang The Book at -149, Covers); BettingNews model leans NO (52.2%). Spread PHX -3.5 (Bang The Book).
401910042.injuries: PHX: Mark Williams out (left shoulder surgery); Ryan Dunn questionable (right quad). NO: Dejounte Murray out (left ankle sprain), Bennedict Mathurin out (left plantar fasciitis), Trendon Watford out (right ankle sprain); Zion Williamson probable (left thigh contusion); Trey Murphy III probable (patellar tendinopathy); Bryce McGowens probable (left elbow infection). Official report, Nov 22.

401910043.summary: Every source picks Houston: the Rockets are 7-1 at home with a much better net rating, while the Clippers are 0-7 on the road on a three-game skid with Beal out. Covers sees Amen Thompson pressuring Garland. Brandon Ingram may debut on a minutes limit, which adds some uncertainty.
401910043.pick: HOU to win (all sources; Bang The Book at -610); Sports Mole: HOU by 8+. Spread HOU -13.5 (Bang The Book).
401910043.predicted_score: HOU 119, LAC 107 (Sports Mole); HOU 118.4, LAC 111.3 (BettingNews model)
401910043.injuries: LAC: Bradley Beal out (knee); Jordan Miller out (shoulder surgery); Brandon Ingram not on the Nov 22 8 PM official report and expected to make his season debut (Achilles), per Heavy; Cam Christie, Nick Martinelli on G League assignment. HOU: Clint Capela day-to-day / game-time decision (ankle). Reports Nov 22.
